password_reset.subject: Choose a new password
password_reset.intro: A new password has been requested for your AquaTracking account.
password_reset.expiry: This link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once.
password_reset.ignore: If you did not request it, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

invitation.subject: {adminName} invites you to AquaTracking
invitation.intro: {adminName} invites you to create an account on their AquaTracking instance, to track the parameters of your aquariums, terrariums and paludariums.
invitation.expiry: This link is valid for 7 days and can be used once.
